thread.title: Special Participation B: Qwen on HW8
thread.content: Below is my report on using Qwen3-Max on the coding part of homework 8. Since Qwen does not accept ipynb or py files I had to download the notebooks as py files and then copy them as text into the Qwen chat. This approach worked surprisingly well, and I am satisfied with its performance on this coding segment of the homework.
